text:
Work smarter with your AI agent in Pumble
    
      
        
        Automate notifications
        Share information to multiple channels with ease. Escape the pain of sending dozens of messages yourself.
      
      
        
        Summarize threads
        Catch up with your team in seconds. Eliminate hours lost sifting through past threads and conversations.
      
      
        
        Find files quickly
        Fetch specific files without sifting through chats yourself. Avoid losing important files ever again.
      
      
        
        Know who to contact
        Use channel and user info to recommend the right place to ask questions. Dodge unnecessary back-and-forths.
      
    
  
  
  
      Connect your AI of choice in 4 simple steps

      
        
          

    

    
    
    
        
            STEP 1
        
        
         Configure apps 

        
            Go to your Pumble workspace settings to set up apps and integrations.
        

        

        
        
        
    

    

        
        
      

      
        
          

    

    
    
    
        
            STEP 2
        
        
         Create a new app 

        
            Go to Create app â Create from scratch to set up your AI agent.
        

        

        
        
        
    

    

        
        
      

      
        
          

    

    
    
    
        
            STEP 3
        
        
         Add app details 

        
            Enter app info and control permissions to limit your AIs access your workspace.
        

        

        
        
        
    

    

        
        
      

      
        
          

    

    
    
    
        
            STEP 4
        
        
         Install the app 

        
            Select Create app to use its app key and install app to use the user and bot tokens.
        

        

        
        
        
    

    

        
        
      

      
        
          

    

    
    
    
        
            STEP 5
        
        
         Connect the app to your AI agent 

        
            Use developer tools (e.g., your terminal) to connect your AI agent with Pumble.
        

        

        
        
        
    

    

        
        
      
      

  

  
  Security and trust

    
        Full control over your AI connection
    

  
      

    

    
    
    
        
        
         Safety 

        
            Your agent is connected via secure API keys to prevent unauthorized access.
        

        

        
        
        
    

    

      

    

    
    
    
        
        
         Permissions
